title: P-cap3: canUnBan name string follows Table 1
description: Extends P11 (mimid-1wgh.3.23), which fixed value 0x000b but not the spelling. draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 §8.1.3 says canUnban; Table 1 (the registry) says canUnBan. Chosen: Table 1, since it is the registry entry: const CAN_UN_BAN, name() returns "canUnBan". The const doc notes the §8.1.3 spelling.
